purpose: Fresh Gate 3 tranche H certification benchmark authored only after r18 was merged, the alternative-source QA contract was merged, and production health reported r18. It was not used to construct r18. It deliberately stresses fresh adjacent cases, multi-authority interactions, conversation continuity, unsupported-rule restraint, and Chief Justice table usefulness.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored only after r18 was merged and production health reported v071-qa-20260917-18; none of its questions was used to construct r18.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade tranche H after its first paid live run; preserve that run as immutable blind evidence.
Any failed tranche-H case may become a regression only after diagnosis; it may not be reused as evidence of a later blind pass.
If candidate behavior changes after tranche H, certify the changed behavior with a newly authored blind tranche.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G questions.
Question-scoped semantic criteria require only what the question asks.
expectedSourceGroups may identify alternative independently sufficient passages; each group is an OR-list, while separate groups remain independently required.

cases.question: During setup, do I secretly arrange my three Territories before choosing which of my four opening cards to discard?
expectedSourcePatterns: After seeing your opening Hand and opening discard

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Choose the opening discard first; only after seeing the resulting opening Hand and discard do you secretly arrange your three Territories.

cases.question: When I set my Hand physically aside while forming a Reserve, have those cards left my Hand for rules purposes?
expectedSourcePatterns: Setting the Hand physically aside during a battle does not move those cards to another zone

semanticCriteria.statement: No. The set-aside cards remain in the Hand zone for rules purposes.

cases.question: A rule directly tells me to bank a card at a stated timing and never says 'as an Action'. Must I spend a separate Action to bank it?

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A direct instruction or permission to bank the card at that timing is part of resolving that effect and does not spend another Action unless it expressly says so.

cases.question: I am at my Asset limit and choose to discard one Asset so I can bank a new one. Does the discarded Asset count as Removed?
expectedSourcePatterns: Replacing an Asset
Removed Assets

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Replacing an Asset at the limit is a voluntary discard used to make room; voluntary discard is not Removal unless a rule expressly says otherwise.

cases.question: An effect gives me two Positions of movement. The first Position enters the opponent and they accept Terms during Onset. Do I still have the second Position afterward?
expectedSourcePatterns: even if the battle sequence ends during Onset

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Initiating the battle ends that movement sequence and all unused movement from it is lost even when the sequence ends during Onset.

cases.question: If Terms are accepted during Onset, do Aftermath effects still get a chance to resolve?
expectedSourceGroups: No battle is fought, no Gambits are set, and there is no winner, loser, or Aftermath

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Accepted Terms end the sequence during Onset; no battle is fought and no Aftermath occurs.

cases.question: My original battle roll had double advantage. The battle totals tie and go to a Tiebreak Roll. Do I roll extra tiebreak dice?
expectedSourcePatterns: Do not apply advantage, disadvantage, card effects, numerical modifiers, or the previous battle totals

semanticCriteria.statement: No. The Tiebreak Roll ignores advantage, disadvantage, ordinary card effects, numerical modifiers, and the previous battle totals unless something expressly modifies a Tiebreak Roll.

cases.question: A battle ends by withdrawal after Gambits were set. Does an effect that triggers when I lose the battle trigger?

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Withdrawal produces no winner or loser, so loss-conditioned effects do not trigger.

cases.question: I win as the attacker on an enemy-controlled Territory two spaces beyond my Front Line. Do I immediately control that Territory just because I won there?
expectedSourcePatterns: Normal result
Front Line

semanticCriteria.statement: No. The winning attacker normally becomes the occupier. Territory control changes through the Front Line/Capture procedure unless a specific effect advances the Front Line.

cases.question: I win the battle that pushes my opponent beyond the Gauntlet. Does that battle itself count as the Last Stand battle for victory?
expectedSourcePatterns: separate legal movement sequence after the battle that forced the opponent beyond the Gauntlet

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Forcing the opponent beyond the Gauntlet does not itself complete the Last Stand route; a separate legal movement sequence must initiate the Last Stand battle, which you must then win.

cases.question: My card pool has several physical copies of a card marked Unique. Can I put two copies in the same Deck?
expectedSourcePatterns: A Unique card is limited to one copy in the Deck

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A Unique card is limited to one copy in the Deck regardless of how many physical copies are available.

cases.question: The attacker and defender each control two effects that trigger at the same battle timing. Does the attacker resolve both of theirs before the defender resolves any?
expectedSourcePatterns: Shared timing

semanticCriteria.statement: No. At that battle timing the attacker applies one controlled effect, then the defender applies one, alternating until no effects remain; each player chooses the order of their own effects.

cases.question: The Military player wins their first battle of the turn while defending during the opponent's turn. Do they gain Command?
expectedSourcePatterns: This trigger may occur during either player's turn

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. The first Military battle victory each turn grants 1 Command even when it occurs while defending on the opponent's turn.

cases.question: The Commandant starts a defensive battle at 0 Command and wins. Can the Command gained from that victory immediately pay for Repel in the same Aftermath?
expectedSourcePatterns: Determine the winner, then gain normal Command
Repel

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Normal Command is gained after determining the winner and before other victory effects, so the newly gained Command can pay for Repel at its Aftermath timing.

cases.question: A Military effect adds a Tactic face up after the normal Tactic reveal. Does that reopen the opponent's Surveillance or Interference window?
expectedSourcePatterns: does not reopen normal Tactic choice, Surveillance, Interference, or reveal windows

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A Military Tactic added after the normal reveal does not reopen normal Tactic choice, Surveillance, Interference, or reveal windows.

cases.question: The opponent withdraws from my battle without a winner. Does Military gain Command from that sequence?
expectedSourcePatterns: Withdrawal has no winner, so it generates no Command

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Withdrawal has no winner and therefore does not generate Command or satisfy a victory-dependent Order.

cases.question: In a Diplomat mirror, the attacking Diplomat passes. The defending Diplomat offers Terms and they are refused. May the attacker now offer their own Terms in that same sequence?
expectedSourcePatterns: Once either player offers Terms, the other cannot offer Terms in that battle sequence

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Once either player offers Terms, the other player cannot offer Terms in that battle sequence even if the Proposal is refused.

cases.question: I offer a Proposal that was already ratified earlier. If the opponent accepts it again, do I gain the normal +1 Influence for ratifying?
expectedSourcePatterns: already-ratified Proposal grants no default ratification reward

semanticCriteria.statement: No. An already-ratified Proposal may be offered again, but accepting it does not grant the normal newly-ratified Influence reward.

cases.question: My Terms are refused, then the resulting battle later ends by withdrawal with no winner. What happens to the Influence I staked and the Proposal?
expectedSourcePatterns: Withdrawal produces no winner. Return the Stake and do not impose the Proposal

semanticCriteria.statement: Return the Stake and do not impose or ratify the Proposal because withdrawal produces no winner.

cases.question: After my Terms are refused, can I spend the Influence still tied up in that Proposal's Stake on Leverage before dice?
expectedSourcePatterns: Staked Influence cannot be spent as Leverage

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Staked Influence remains unavailable for Leverage; only other available Influence may be spent.

cases.question: Financial Capacity is active after Capture because my Treasury value exceeds my controlled Territories. If my Treasury value later drops during the turn, do I lose the second-Action permission?
expectedSourcePatterns: Determine eligibility once at this timing; later Treasury or control changes do not grant or remove the permission that turn

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Financial Capacity eligibility is determined once after Capture; later Treasury or control changes do not remove or newly grant that turn's permission.

cases.question: My Capital is above my current limit at the end of the opponent's turn. Do I wait until the end of my own turn to trim it?
expectedSourcePatterns: At the end of every turn, including an opponent's turn

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Capital above the current limit is reduced at the end of every turn, including the opponent's turn.

cases.question: An effect lets me make two Deed purchases in sequence. Do I calculate both prices from the number of Deeds I owned before the first purchase?
expectedSourcePatterns: complete each purchase before recalculating the next cost

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Complete the first purchase, then recalculate the next Deed cost using the new ownership state.

cases.question: My opponent captures a Territory whose Deed I own. Does control of the Territory automatically transfer its Deed to them?
expectedSourcePatterns: Changing Territory control does not transfer its Deed

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Deed ownership is independent of Territory control; changing control does not transfer the Deed.

cases.question: I already satisfied a card's Mission condition earlier this turn, then start that card as my Active Mission in Denouement. May that earlier event count toward completing it later?
expectedSourcePatterns: Its printed requirement counts only while it is the Active Mission

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A Mission's printed requirement counts only while that card is the Active Mission; events before it became Active do not satisfy the Mission.

cases.question: My Special Operation is face down and ready. The opponent gains enough controlled Territories that my Operation Progress no longer exceeds their total. What happens immediately?
expectedSourcePatterns: If readiness is lost, it immediately fails and goes to the Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: The Special Operation immediately fails and goes to the Graveyard when readiness is lost.

cases.question: I used Gambit Surveillance earlier in this battle. May I still use Tactic Surveillance when the opponent chooses face-down Tactics?
expectedSourcePatterns: The Gambit and Tactic opportunities are independent

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Gambit and Tactic Surveillance are separate once-per-battle opportunities; using one does not consume the other.

cases.question: I Interfere with a revealed opposing Tactic and they replace it from Reserve. Can I immediately Surveil or Interfere with that replacement again?
expectedSourcePatterns: The replacement creates no new Surveillance, Interference, reveal, or response opportunity

semanticCriteria.statement: No. The replacement comes from the same source as allowed, but it creates no new Surveillance, Interference, reveal, or response opportunity.

cases.question: My active Rite still has not completed, but a required game state changes so its completion condition can no longer be met. Does the Rite just wait?
expectedSourcePatterns: If an active Rite can no longer be completed

semanticCriteria.statement: No. If an active Rite can no longer be completed because a required card, component, position, or game state is lost or changes, it is immediately interrupted and resets.

cases.question: I copy the effect of an Arcane card sitting in the Graveyard without playing, setting, or choosing that Arcane card again. Does Invocation trigger?
expectedSourcePatterns: A copied effect does not trigger Invocation

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Merely applying or copying an Arcane card's effect does not trigger Invocation unless that Arcane card itself is played, set, or chosen again and its printed effect is applied.

cases.question: I use Transmutation and put a card from Hand into my Graveyard. Do I also apply that card's printed Action, Gambit, or Tactic effect?
expectedSourcePatterns: The card is not played and none of its printed effects apply

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A card sacrificed to Transmutation is not played and none of its printed effects apply.

cases.question: While my Ritual of Ascension is underway, a battle ends by withdrawal without a winner. Does that complete or interrupt the Ritual?
expectedSourcePatterns: Withdrawal neither completes nor interrupts the Ritual

semanticCriteria.statement: Neither. Withdrawal has no winner or loser, so it neither completes nor interrupts the Ritual.

cases.question: Three opposing cards enter the Graveyard during the same qualifying battle Aftermath, and I did not win that battle. How much normal Conviction do I gain from that event?
expectedSourcePatterns: Several qualifying cards from the same battle still produce only 1 normal gain

semanticCriteria.statement: Gain 1 normal Conviction. Winning is not required, and several qualifying opposing cards from the same battle still produce only one normal gain.

cases.question: My opponent copies an Arcane card's effect without playing or revealing that Arcane card. Does Blasphemy gain Conviction?
expectedSourcePatterns: Merely copying an Arcane card's effect does not count as playing or revealing that card

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Copying an Arcane effect without playing or revealing the Arcane card does not trigger Blasphemy.

cases.question: I spend my Opening Action on Purge. May I then take my additional allowed Action during Denouement, and could I instead take both Actions during Opening?
expectedSourcePatterns: Purge never permits two Actions during the same phase

semanticCriteria.statement: You may take the other allowed Action during Denouement, but Purge never permits two Actions in the same phase.

cases.question: The opponent cannot draw the cards needed to form a Reserve because both their Draw Pile and Discard Pile are empty. Does that trigger Purification?
expectedSourcePatterns: A failed Reserve draw or effect-generated draw does not trigger Purification

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Purification checks only the opponent's normal start-of-turn draw attempt, not a failed Reserve draw or effect-generated draw.

cases.question: The General is defending a battle they did not initiate. Can Rally be used before dice?

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Rally is an attacking Order and applies only in a battle the General initiated.

cases.question: The Commandant wins while defending a Territory they already control. Can Fortify be used from that victory?

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Fortify requires winning while occupying an enemy Territory; defending a Territory already controlled by the Commandant does not satisfy that condition.

cases.question: The Ambassador offers a Proposal that was ratified earlier and the opponent accepts it. Does Cordiality still draw a card?
expectedSourcePatterns: may be offered again for its tactical effects
Cordiality

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. A ratified Proposal may still be offered as Terms, and Cordiality triggers after the opponent accepts the Ambassador's Terms even though no new ratification occurs.

cases.question: The Senator is about to lose a Stake of 2 Influence after losing a battle. They put one card from Hand in the Graveyard for Political Capital. How much of the Stake is recovered?

semanticCriteria.statement: Recover 1 staked Influence for the one card placed in the Graveyard; the remaining 1 staked Influence is lost.

cases.question: The Banker's first Deed purchase this turn costs 5 Capital. With Line of Credit, how much can the collateral contribute and how much Capital must still be paid?

semanticCriteria.statement: The collateral contributes at most 2 toward a cost of 5 because half is rounded down, so the Banker must pay the remaining 3 Capital.

cases.question: The Executive successfully uses Hostile Takeover to buy a Deed, but their Front Line cannot legally advance afterward. Does the Deed purchase still stand?

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. The purchase is already successful; the subsequent Front Line advance occurs only if able and is not a condition of the purchase.

cases.question: Can the Ranger spend Intel on Fieldcraft to make a Territory count as controlled for Capture or a Territory-based limit?

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Fieldcraft can ignore a printed Territory effect, but it does not alter Territory control, Capture, or limits calculated from Territories.

cases.question: After the Spymaster completes a normal Mission, does using Mission Control to start the next eligible Mission spend another Action?

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Mission Control is a No Action Leader Ability that immediately starts another eligible normal Mission; that Mission cannot complete that turn and cannot be a Special Operation.

cases.question: The Alchemist's first qualifying Hand-to-Graveyard sacrifice this turn is Transmutation during a battle. When does Materia Prima draw its card?

semanticCriteria.statement: Materia Prima qualifies, but because the sacrifice occurs during battle the draw waits until after the Aftermath.

cases.question: The Spirit Walker has completed two Rites. What minimum card value is required to use Guardians of the Circle against a battle-loss interruption?

semanticCriteria.statement: The sacrificed Arcane card must have value at least 3: one plus the two completed Rites.

cases.question: The Grand Inquisitor wins a battle at 0 Conviction and an opposing Gambit enters the Graveyard in that Aftermath. Can the normal Conviction gained from that battle be spent on the immediate Final Judgment Purge?

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Normal Conviction from that battle may be gained before Final Judgment, and Final Judgment then reduces that Purge's Conviction cost by 1 to a minimum of 1.

cases.question: Relentless Pursuit advances the Witch Hunter into the opponent and starts another battle. Who is the attacker in that new battle?

semanticCriteria.statement: The Witch Hunter is the attacker in the new battle started by Relentless Pursuit.

cases.question: Armistice is banked. Can its controller use the normal 'discard an Asset as an Action' option during Denouement to get rid of it?
expectedSourceGroups: cannot voluntarily discard this card at another time

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Armistice specifically forbids voluntary discard except at its stated start-of-Opening procedure, so the generic Asset-discard Action cannot be used to discard it during Denouement.

cases.question: Reserve Force is banked with a Tactic bound face down beneath it. If Reserve Force leaves play before that Tactic is used, where does the bound card go?
expectedSourceGroups: If this card leaves play with a bound card

semanticCriteria.statement: The bound card goes to its owner's Graveyard because Reserve Force gives that card-specific destination when the Asset leaves play.

cases.question: I use Sabotage as a battle card to negate an opposing Gambit. Does that Gambit wait until the Aftermath and then go to the Graveyard?
expectedSourceGroups: put it in its owner's Discard Pile immediately

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Sabotage specifically puts the negated opposing Gambit or Tactic in its owner's Discard Pile immediately.

cases.question: I attack an Intelligence player at Watchtower while they have Counterintelligence. Watchtower makes my Gambit face up from the start. Can Counterintelligence stop that?
expectedSourcePatterns: Because the attacker's Gambit was never face down, Counterintelligence does not prevent the reveal

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Watchtower makes the attacker's Gambit face up rather than revealing a face-down card, so Counterintelligence does not prevent it; Intelligence may instead use Direct Interference at the proper timing.

cases.question: A Military player wins a battle against the Inquisition, but Condemnation sends the Tactic they chose to their Graveyard. During Denouement, can Battlefield Promotion return that Tactic to Hand?
expectedSourcePatterns: Condemnation
Battlefield Promotion

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Battlefield Promotion can return a Tactic from the Discard Pile, but Condemnation put that Tactic in the Graveyard instead, so it is not an eligible card for Battlefield Promotion.

cases.question: A Mystic uses Invocation to move a card from their Graveyard to their Discard Pile while the opponent has Anathema banked. If the opponent discards Anathema for its effect, does the card move?
expectedSourcePatterns: Anathema
Invocation

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Anathema can stop the opponent-controlled Graveyard-to-other-zone movement, so the card remains in the Mystic's Graveyard.

cases.question: What if a card specifically says '+1 on your Tiebreak Roll'?

history.content: My battle totals tied. Does the advantage I had on the battle roll carry into the Tiebreak Roll?
No. Ordinary advantage, disadvantage, card effects, and battle-total modifiers are ignored in a Tiebreak Roll unless something expressly modifies the Tiebreak Roll.

expectedSourcePatterns: Tiebreak Roll

semanticCriteria.statement: That explicit Tiebreak Roll modifier applies, because the rule allows an effect to modify the Tiebreak Roll when it expressly refers to that procedure.

cases.question: Then I withdraw before dice. Do I lose the Stake?

history.content: I offered Terms with a 2-Influence Stake and the opponent refused.
The battle continues, and the Stake remains tied up while the outcome is unresolved.

expectedSourcePatterns: Withdrawal produces no winner. Return the Stake and do not impose the Proposal

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A later withdrawal produces no winner, so the Diplomat returns the Stake and does not impose the refused Proposal.

cases.question: If I replace the Asset to make room, where does that card go?

history.content: I banked Reserve Force and bound a Tactic from my Hand face down beneath it.
Reserve Force is the banked Asset, and the Tactic is the face-down card bound to it.

expectedSourcePatterns: Reserve Force

semanticCriteria.statement: The bound Tactic goes to its owner's Graveyard when Reserve Force leaves play, because Reserve Force gives its bound card that specific destination.

cases.question: They capture another Territory before my Denouement. What happens now?

history.content: My Operation Progress is 4, the opponent controls 3 Territories, and I already started a Special Operation.
It is currently ready because 4 exceeds 3, assuming its other requirements remain satisfied.

expectedSourcePatterns: If readiness is lost, it immediately fails and goes to the Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: The Special Operation immediately fails and goes to the Graveyard if the opponent's additional controlled Territory means Operation Progress no longer exceeds their controlled Territories.

cases.question: At the start of my turn, an Asset I control and an opponent-controlled Asset both trigger at the same time, and neither effect gives an order. Which player's effect resolves first?

semanticCriteria.statement: The written shared-timing procedure orders attacker and defender effects during battle but does not establish a general priority rule for simultaneous controlled effects outside a battle. The Arbiter should identify that gap and make a provisional table ruling rather than claim an explicit written priority.

cases.question: Which faction is strongest overall in v0.7.1?

semanticCriteria.statement: This is a balance/evaluation question rather than a gameplay-rules ruling, so it should be treated as out of scope for the Rules Arbiter.

cases.question: Can you write flavor text for a new Financier card?

semanticCriteria.statement: This is a creative game-design/writing request rather than a v0.7.1 gameplay-rules ruling and should be treated as out of scope.
